rec.description: Model family 'tiny' horizontal reader v6: MobileNetV4-small 0.5 CTC (324k params, 154 M MACs), 48x768, 91 classes (74 kana + space + 0-9 ! ? : / . -, same ids as the family readers), fine-tuned from the family reader's float checkpoint (fam_tiny_h48b): stage 1 on lines_v6 (generator v6, hxh-synth --v6: digits and ! ? : / . - written into the Hunter lettering, drawn as strokes in the glyphs' own weight and ends or set in bold / condensed display faces matched to the stroke weight, touching digit pairs, italic ! ?, realistic numbers; kana reading guides (furigana) above lines as distractors; sticker lettering; product-promo scenes) (twice) + lines_v5b + synth_v4, stage 2 on lines_v6 + lines_v6m (small dakuten dots) + lines_v5b + synth_v4 (twice, about 70% of the lines); QAT, int8 via ESP-PPQ PTQ, .hxhm bit-exact with ESP-PPQ (host engine, naive reference, wasm SIMD, wasm scalar).

rec_v.description: Unchanged copy of the family 'tiny' vertical reader qat_fam_tiny_h48_vert (model_v.hxhm and model_v.json as in experiments/family/tiny/); digits inside vertical Hunter text are rare, so it was not retrained for v6.
